profile.summary: Cinevista Limited engages in the production and distribution of television programmes, ad commercials, and feature films in India and internationally. It offers commercial television content in the areas of action, adventure, kids programming, drama, soap, and reality content. The company also produces and distributes movies; and produces advertising commercials for various clients and advertisers
